payload.feedback: Rejected pending rework. The API/authentication and opaque-payload boundary are otherwise supported by RUN-008 and the focused tests, but append/replay semantics are incorrect for a versioned envelope identity: `libs/shared/src/lib/crypto/opaque-sync.ts:26-41` uses `records.find(...)`, so after revision 1 is appended and revision 2 is appended, a retry of revision 2 is compared with the old revision-1 record and is appended again (not idempotent), while a retry of the old revision 1 can be accepted as a duplicate rather than rejected as replay. Track/compare the latest revision per account/workspace/envelopeId and add tests for revision advancement followed by retries of both the new and old revisions. Also preserve cursor monotonicity across retention: `opaque-sync.ts:43` derives the next cursor from the last retained record, so once all records expire the cursor resets to 1; add a persistent/high-water cursor (or equivalent documented guarantee) and a test covering append-after-full-prune.
